title: prompt-lifecycle — your words become names, cards and a proposal while you are still talking

set.request: prompt-lifecycle - your words become names, cards and a proposal while you are still talking. A Servex-hosted fast assistant that answers every dictated sentence with names, a card and a refined reading; a Prompts view on the AI board showing the thread live; optional check/cross per item; a pre-proposal on approval; headless proof end to end.
set.now: proven end to end - writing the report page
steps: Read the system - Servex routes, Log.append naming checks, Agents host, roles, the v/3 board and its agents strip
Assistant.js - the assistant role agent spawned on boot, every prompt line sent to it, one MCP tool to answer with events
Stream.js - broadcast log events (prompts) to the browser, not just agent events
The Prompts view on /framework/ai/v/3/ - verbatim sentences, the refined reading with cited sentences, name chips, live
Cards fold onto the normal timeline from the prompts log; write the shared-fold decision
Optional approve/dispute/ask per chip and card, inline, never mandatory
Proof headless - five real prompts, latencies, two screenshots, the Servex-down path
The report page, the day page line, land
set.outcome:
**Your spoken words become names, cards and a pre-proposal while you are still talking — median 2.05 seconds.**

A Sonnet assistant now lives inside Servex and never goes away. Every sentence you dictate lands in the prompt log, and about two seconds later it has a name for each thing you named, a card for the idea, and a short reading of what you said that points at the exact sentences it came from. The [Prompts view](/framework/ai/v/3/?view=prompts) is the fifth tab on the AI board: your words on the left, never tidied, what was made of them on the right. Hover a reading and the sentences it cites light up.

Nothing waits for you. A check or a cross on any name chip or card is optional, always — a check locks the name and, on a card, asks for a pre-proposal; a cross files what is wrong with it beside the name rather than over it. Every card the assistant makes also joins the normal timeline and grid.

![](/framework/ai/2026-09-22/prompt-lifecycle/shots/thread.png)

- [The report page](/framework/ai/2026-09-22/prompt-lifecycle/) — the five stages, which are live, the numbers
- [The Prompts view](/framework/ai/v/3/?view=prompts) — the thing itself
- [The event schema](/framework/ai/2026-09-22/log-model/) — what a prompt, a name and a card are

**Proven, headless:** five real sentences of yours posted one every eight seconds answered in 2023, 2029, 2050, 2832 and 3270 ms; six names, five cards, five readings, no misses. A check appended an approve and locked the chip; a cross with a typed reason filed a dispute under it; a check on a card brought back a pre-proposal with three bullets two seconds later. One column at 400px with no overflow. With Servex down the board loads and says so, with zero page errors.

**Left on purpose:** stages 4 and 5 (a full proposal naming classes, and the build) are phase 3 of your own brief. Two things are written up in the log — the AI board builds its whole view twice on every load (an old fault, not from this task, but it doubles any count taken off that page), and `Servex/readme.md` still does not name the assistant because that file was outside this task's fence.
